notes.title: Big update out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Biggest Changes[/h2]
[h3]New Map[/h3]
Winter themed map with lots of new enemies

[h3]New Player Characters[/h3]
[b]Zeus[/b]
Special property: +20% damage (all weapons)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/f826c07b4bdf36c1912d36f287e6584bfcecf597.png[/img]

[b]Robin Cap[/b]
Special property: +25% movement speed
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/d05a436e51ab66bb0398c8c0dd1fae71353bb543.png[/img]

[b]Cleric[/b]
Special property: +100 max. health
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/892bfbbfe4da80e8dede53724fd57cd79698ecc9.png[/img]

[b]Angel[/b]
Special property: +25% weapon attack area (all weapons)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/2e2dfec32e5ba1e53c1b0dbb4a29f616b542692f.png[/img]

[b]Satan[/b]
Special property: +15% critical damage chance (all weapons)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/8f10098ad4160b40bf226d8019c769143019dc5a.png[/img]

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
[b]Thunder Bolt[/b]
Creates lightning which attacks nearby enemies

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/3f93df143bc265abc670cb6c2b8a567050e0b493.png[/img]

[b]Poison[/b]
Throws potion and damages enemies in poison area

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/5d42a36e8cb83e3bd673f924db205a14c9804b36.png[/img]

[b]Holy Nova[/b]
Heals player when enemies get hit by holy nova

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/c313dedaf7db990da4e03ab5d5e7b1da4cc5bbb5.png[/img]

[b]Shooting Star[/b]
Falls onto enemy and damages nearby enemies

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/6e431737ac93071f8cf6fe8c0604223ce86b5e7d.png[/img]

[b]Fire Ball[/b]
Burns enemies which got hit by the fire ball

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42464477/eadb117988e504fb6be74e431ac177081c0c59de.png[/img]

[h3]New Special Items[/h3]
[b]Shield[/b]
Makes player immune for a short period of time

[b]Holy Heart[/b]
Completely restores health of the player

[h3]New Soundtracks[/h3]
Five new soundtracks so you don't get bored of the music too fast :)

[hr][/hr][h2]Small Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved texture for: Knight, Lancelot, Merlout
[*] Knives now target the nearest enemies instead of flying in walking direction
[*] Increased attack area of sword
[*] More chickens!
[*] Various small bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 17.06.2022
notes.content:
- Added support for moving player using arrow keys
- Show movement controls at the start of the game
- Some small bug fixes
